contexts.text: From relatives... a sphere of perception...
From opposites apperceived relatives are procured...
From these alternations they have relatives; and, from relatives, a more perfect perception.
There would not be anything relative to the Itself.
No virtue can be presented... except by relatives...
Opposites are not relatives... Relatives are between the greatest and least of the same Thing...
The perception of opposites is different from that of relatives. Explained.
As God perceives... all the relatives in Heaven... and thereby perceives... all the opposite relatives in Hell...
For there to be anything there must be what is relative to contraries. WE 1151:end.
All things are relatives; and without the perception of contraries there are no relatives...
